sloka: एवं तैर्वानरैः शूरैः शूरास्ते रजनीचराः ।द्वन्द्वे विमृदितास्तत्र दैत्या इव दिवौकसैः ।। ६.४३.४२ ।।।।
transliteration: evaṁ tairvānaraiḥ śūraiḥ śūrāste rajanīcarāḥ ।dvandve vimṛditāstatra daityā iva divaukasaiḥ ।। 6.43.42 ।।।।

translations.english: The battlefield was dreadful and, frequented by jackals with spears, javelins, maces, and swords, strewn all over, similarly with broken chariots, horses, elephants, and monkeys fit for war. Broken wheels and axles of chariots were found all over.
